layout.title: Organization
layout.subtitle: Manage your organization settings and members

settings.title: Organization Settings

profile.title: Organization profile
profile.description: The organization's name, its URL slug, and the logo shown across the dashboard and its status pages.
profile.name: Name
profile.renameWarning: Every URL of this organization changes — dashboard links, status pages, SVG badges and embedded widgets. Existing links keep working: the old address redirects to the new one, but only until another organization claims it.
profile.logoHelp: Paste an image URL, or upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG of up to 1 MB.

settings.autoJoinDescription: Automatically add users matching this email pattern to the organization.
settings.autoJoinFullDescription: Users whose email matches this pattern will automatically join this organization when they register or sign in via OAuth.
settings.autoJoinHelp: Leave empty to disable auto-join. Example: @example\.com$ matches all @example.com emails. Free-mail providers (Gmail, Outlook, etc.) and overly broad patterns are rejected.
settings.sessionDurationFullDescription: Set a hard limit on how long a login session can last, regardless of activity. Leave empty to use the platform default (no limit unless one is set system-wide).
settings.sessionDurationHelp: Once set, a session is force-expired this many hours after login even if the user stays active — separate from the 7-day inactivity timeout.
settings.defaultEscalationDescription: Applied to checks that resolve to no policy of their own (check → group → org default → none). Leave unset for no org-wide fallback.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Irreversible actions. Only owners can see this section.
dangerZone.deleteHelp: Deleting {{org}} removes its checks, status pages, members and history. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.confirmBody: This permanently deletes {{org}}: every check stops running, its status pages and badges stop responding, and everybody loses access. This cannot be undone.

traceroute.title: Network path diagnostics
traceroute.description: When a check goes down because its target could not be REACHED, capture an MTR-style traceroute and attach it to the incident.
traceroute.label: Traceroute on network failure
traceroute.help: Applies to every check set to "inherit". Only reachability failures trigger a capture — connect timeouts, refusals, ICMP loss, stalled TLS handshakes. An HTTP 5xx, a keyword mismatch or an expiring certificate never does, because the server answered. Traces run after the failing result is already reported and are rate-limited per organization, so they never delay an incident or flood a mass outage.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Your current plan limits and how much of each you're using.
usage.multiRegionNote: A multi-region check runs in every selected region, so it consumes regions × 60s / period checks per minute.

smsGuard.title: Some SMS alerts were not sent
smsGuard.runaway: {{count}} message(s) were refused because this instance's SMS cap of {{limit}}/hour was reached. Alerts are being dropped instance-wide — tell your operator.
smsGuard.country: {{count}} message(s) were refused because the destination country is outside this instance's allow-list ({{countries}}).

paging.title: Set up paging
paging.unverifiedTitle: Contacts you add here start unverified
paging.unverifiedBody: You are saving your colleague the typing, not the verification. Nothing pages this number until they confirm it is theirs from their own notification settings.
paging.added: Contact added — the member still has to verify it
paging.nudgeBody: Sends an email asking them to add and verify a paging contact. Contains no contact data and no verification code.
paging.nudgeFailed: Could not send the nudge email
